description: Fetch real-time abuse statistics for a ScopeBlind tenant. Shows total requests, unique devices, abuse rate, and estimated dollar waste.

cost_per_request.description: Cost per request in dollars (e.g. 0.01 for LLM API calls). Used to estimate dollar waste from abuse.

slug.description: The tenant slug (e.g. "a1b2c3d4e5f6"). Get this from provision_tenant or the ScopeBlind dashboard URL.

name: get_abuse_report
